description: Upload an image or video to YourImageShare and get back a shareable link. Accepts JPG, PNG, GIF, WEBP, AVIF, BMP, TIFF, HEIC/HEIF images and MP4, WEBM, AVI video, 100KB-200MB. Provide `path` for a file on disk this server can read, or `base64` + `filename` for in-memory content (e.g. no local filesystem access) - never both. Returns three different URLs for the same upload (see output fields): a raw storage link, a direct embeddable link, and a shareable page link - pick whichever fits where it's going. Errors (oversized/unsupported file, bad API key, rate limit) come back as a normal tool error, not a thrown exception.

expiresIn.description: Auto-delete after this many seconds (60 to 2,592,000 = 30 days). Omit for a permanent upload.

filename.description: Filename to use. Required with `base64`; inferred from `path` otherwise.

name: upload_image

direct.description: The shareable page URL (title, description, comments, share buttons). Despite the field name, this is NOT a direct file link - use `src` for that.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 auto-delete timestamp, or null if the upload never expires.

id.description: Unique identifier for this upload. Pass to delete_upload to remove it.

path.description: Raw storage URL - the literal file, e.g. i.yourimageshare.com/xxx.webp.

src.description: Direct/embeddable file URL - use this for /

title: Upload an image or video
